evaluation: Only the Writer evaluates this, from its own prefix state, for capacity admission. No input is read from tape bytes, so no vector can reach it. The payload-length part is covered on the Reader side by overflow-10.4-slot-product.
formula: close reserve = parity closeout + (64 × structural_row_count + 256 × object_row_count) in three rounded replica records + both separation extents + five filemark charges
quotes: A tape's close reserve is the space its finalization needs: parity closeout, the checked terminal payload `64 × structural_row_count + 256 × object_row_count` in three rounded replica records, both separation extents, and five filemark charges.
target: Writer capacity admission (Section 10.3; practice in the Guide)
